name: start-a-timer-from-notion-task

trigger.trigger_note: The catch URL is what the Notion Tasks DB automation must POST to — NOT trigger_url above, which is Zapier-internal. It first appeared when version 019fa2d9 was published WITH --trigger; the UI migration had left the trigger unclaimed (details: null), so nothing could reach the Zap. Disabling the workflow moves the trigger to status "released" but keeps this URL; re-enabling restores "active" with the same URL.

description: Notion Tasks 'Track Time' button -> start (or restart) a Harvest timer for that task, booked to the Harvest project mapped to the task's Notion Project. One timer per task per day: the (task, day) -> time entry mapping lives in Zapier Table 01K5060J1B1FHCJEWVVH597B71, so a second click the same day restarts the existing entry instead of creating a duplicate. Migrated from the classic Zap of the same name via the Durables UI; the migration output was non-functional and was rewritten (see README).

version_history.note: Durables-UI migration of the classic Zap. Never ran: the source does not parse (TS1005/TS1160), four Zapier template expressions were left unresolved as literal strings, two step outputs were mis-bound to `input`, and the trigger was left unclaimed.

Rewrite of the migration. Fixes all eleven defects in the README table, resolves both user ids, claims the trigger, moves 0.8.0 -> 0.10.1, and drops dayjs. Typechecks; the actor-guard and no-project paths verified with run-durable against the live runner (no writes).
